Tradingjeti, it has a lot to do that Australia (AUDUSD affected e.g) is a commodity currency, the same as Canada (USDCAD affected e.g). These countries possess large quantaties of natural resources such as gold, iron and coal.

Now what happened is that these resources broke down 10% of its value the last days and still there is room for a further decline. Therefore the Aussie dollar struggles and is also losing value...

So all in all you did a good job by finding a demand level but the situation right now is just that the currency is too expensive because of the breakdown of the natural resource prices.
